exposure: Robson Classification Group 5 (with previous cesarean section)
outcome: Distribution of cesarean sections by Robson classification
cohort: Newborns delivered via cesarean section at teaching hospitals participating in the Project for Improvement and Innovation in the Care and Teaching of Obstetrics and Neonatology (Apice ON) in Brazil
finding: Brazilian teaching hospitals displayed higher cesarean section rates than WHO recommendations for all Robson classification groups, including those considered low risk.
mod_finding: The study examines cesarean section rates across different risk groups but does not specifically analyze outcomes related to mode of delivery.
cross-section timing: the year prior to project implementation
